Lead A (round 3).recommended_vessel: Pilot reactor / mixing tank (50 L–1 m³)
Lead A (round 3).notes: Resolved manufacturing process: blending. Scale tier: Pilot (Pilot reactor / mixing tank (50 L–1 m³)). Cycle time scales with batch size via a cube-root mixing-time heuristic (reference batch: 50 kg).

risks.mitigation: Mixing time generally increases with vessel diameter — verify homogeneity with in-process sampling at 3 vessel heights, not just impeller-tip speed matching.
